title: Poincaré conjecture (3-dimensional, topological)
aliases: 庞加莱猜想（历史已解决）

statement.text: Every closed, simply connected topological 3-manifold is homeomorphic to the standard 3-sphere S³.

domain.description: Closed, simply connected topological 3-manifolds: Hausdorff spaces locally homeomorphic to R^3, compact, and without boundary, with the standard notion of simple connectivity.

definitions.definition: A compact topological 3-manifold without boundary; here a topological 3-manifold is Hausdorff and locally homeomorphic to R^3.
Path connected, with every based loop homotopic through based loops to the constant loop; equivalently, the fundamental group is trivial.
The unit sphere {x in R^4 | ||x|| = 1} with its subspace topology.
There exists a bijection between the spaces that is continuous with continuous inverse.

assumptions: No differentiable, PL, Riemannian, triangulated, or orientable structure is assumed in the theorem statement.
The conclusion is a homeomorphism to the standard 3-sphere, not merely a homotopy equivalence, diffeomorphism under extra hypotheses, finite verification, or a conditional geometrization statement.

sources.source: Clay Mathematics Institute — Official Problem Description by John Milnor
